subject.title: fix #100368: mark undelivered message_tool_only finals in replay

question: After the queued text-matching defect is fixed, should OpenClaw permanently represent an undelivered `message_tool_only` final as a hidden model-consumed custom transcript record?
rationale: The marker is technically suitable for restoring delivery reality, but adding a durable record that affects future model context is a compatibility-sensitive session contract requiring maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept hidden marker
options.body: Adopt the hidden custom record as the canonical durable representation once both runners use exact final-text delivery evidence.

options.title: Use replay projection
options.body: Keep stored transcripts unchanged and inject an undelivered annotation only while constructing model context.

options.title: Pause representation change
options.body: Retain existing recovery behavior and defer the durable delivery-state model to a broader session design.

recommendation.title: Accept hidden marker
recommendation.body: Adopt the hidden custom record as the canonical durable representation once both runners use exact final-text delivery evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged recovery implementation owns the current behavior and the boundary this representation extends.
